title: Birnok
description: As one of the Empire's prisoners on Narkina 5, Birnok toiled tirelessly to manufacture the mysterious widgets his team on Table Two were forced to work on. He was skilled at his labor and had a great eye for detail, but that didn't stop him from having to go "on program" when Kino Loy called for it, nor did it save his life when the prison uprising began.
